ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
